# Sample Trail

> Runs the quality approval decision on a physical commodity sample, from dispatch to verdict, on a
> phone. Seven n8n workflows. A model reads a photographed grading sheet into named values; a
> deterministic Code node compares those against the contract specification; a named person decides.

Sample Trail serves agri-food and soft commodities: coffee, cocoa, grain, sugar, cotton, nuts. The
quality parameters are rows in a store, one per parameter, so the same workflows serve any of them
without a code change.

It is not a LIMS, not a traceability system and not a grading standard. It does not track where a
sample physically is. It keeps the decision record: which sample, against which specification,
judged by whom, on what evidence, and who was told.

The verdict never comes from a model. The engine has no clock, no randomness and no network, so the
same reading against the same specification produces the same verdict a year later.

## Files

- [README](README.md): what it does, how to install it, and the specification format
- [Scope and limits](SCOPE.md): what it does not do and where it breaks
- [Compliance](COMPLIANCE.md): EU AI Act classification and where a model is used
- [Workflows](workflows/): the seven importable files
- [Sheet templates](sheets/): a CSV per tab, with the columns and fictional seed rows
